title: Kill Ennodius Papius
description: A Dark Brotherhood side contract given by Nazir to assassinate Ennodius Papius, a paranoid ex-miller camped near Anga's Mill, and return for a leveled gold reward.

base_facts: I am a Redguard assassin of the Dark Brotherhood stationed at the Sanctuary.
I manage the smaller side contracts for the Brotherhood.
A contract has been placed on the life of Ennodius Papius.

CONTRACT_GIVEN: I have assigned the contract to kill Ennodius Papius, a paranoid ex-miller hiding at a camp near Anga's Mill.
TARGET_DEAD: The contract on Ennodius Papius has been fulfilled. I await the killer's return to the Sanctuary.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have paid the reward for the Ennodius Papius contract. The deed is done.

base_facts: I am a paranoid former miller living in a camp just up the road from Anga's Mill.
I fled the mill and now live in isolation, consumed by fear.

CONTRACT_GIVEN: Someone is coming for me. My paranoia was justified.

beats.comment: Nazir assigns the contract to kill Ennodius Papius. Stage 10 fires when the quest is accepted.
Ennodius Papius has been killed. Stage 20 updates the objective to report back to Nazir.
Player reports back to Nazir and collects the leveled gold reward. Stage 200 finishes the quest.
